instrument: Rule 15, Companies (Meetings of Board and its Powers) Rules, 2014 (as amended)

candidate_limbs.extraction_note: from a DEFECTIVE extraction of Rule 15, amended over time. The single pct_of_turnover / pct_of_net_worth values here are a SIMPLIFICATION -- the real Rule has PER-TRANSACTION-TYPE limbs the held fragments show as: goods ~25% of turnover; property/leasing/services ~10% of net worth or turnover; underwriting ~1% of net worth; office of profit ~Rs 2.5 lakh/month; plus a paid-up-capital class trigger the 2019 amendment may have removed. A reviewer MUST verify every limb against a clean dated copy and decide how to encode the per-type granularity before attesting. Do NOT serve these unread.
